timing: Read-only protocol review clarifications after public-byte downloads, before parsing source graphs, fitting baselines or computing any benchmark outcome. Original protocol is preserved unchanged.
empty_graphs: All 50 sampled nodes retained. Density, mean clustering, global efficiency, transitivity and degree Gini are zero; largest-component fraction is 1/50. Gini of all-zero degrees is defined as zero for this new benchmark, not a rewrite of a primary metric.
primary_weighting: Within each of the 16 method/model groups, assign each of seven instruction conditions weight 1/7; divide that weight equally among its valid, defined graph outcomes. Retain all failure rows and original n=56 denominator. Distances are conditional on valid/defined outcomes and do not assess failure quality. Abort if any condition has zero defined outcomes for an evaluated metric. No failed graph is zero-filled.
other_weights: Within each held-out cohort, give each of 32 node draws weight 1/32. Within each baseline bank, use uniform weights over its 56 synthetic graphs. Average cohort-level distances equally within source; do not treat draws as independent populations.
conditional_controls: G(n,m) and degree-swap controls do NOT enter transfer W1 ranking. For each target draw/metric, compute observed minus mean of eight controls only if all eight succeed. No target is overweighted because it has more successful controls. Retain all failures/coverage. Summarize a cohort/control/metric only when all 32 target draws are complete; otherwise mean residual is missing, with complete-target count reported. This is a conditional structural diagnostic, not a confidence interval or null p-value.
